bio.text: Andrew Parrott is the Libertarian candidate for Florida's 6th Congressional District in 2026; he was also the Libertarian candidate in the April 2025 special election for the seat.
WKMG ClickOrlando lists his age as 54.
In a 2025 interview he said he had been more closely associated with the Republican Party for most of his life before joining the Libertarian Party.

sources.title: An Interview with Congressional Candidate Andrew Parrott
